During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] initiated a '''blockade''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berason]] due to its [[Politics/Legends|political]] views using [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine|Defender ion mines]]. The blockade was broken by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] by sending men out in [[Environment suit/Legends|vacc-suits]] and [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to disable the [[Mine/Legends|mines]].<ref name="CRFG" />
